# Motion graphics and kinetic type

**Title cards, lower thirds and word-per-beat type for shorts: on the beat, in the safe zone, rendered with any ffmpeg or an editor.**

Adds animated text and simple motion to vertical shorts — title cards, lower thirds, word-per-beat kinetic type, end cards and an on-screen AI tag — timed to the music's beat, kept inside the app safe zones and exported to the master spec. Covers four routes (an HTML layer animated with a tested ffmpeg overlay script that works on any build, ASS word slams, ffmpeg drawtext, and editors like CapCut, Resolve and Premiere) plus AI video as a moving background with the text added afterwards. Use when a short needs a title card, a lower third, kinetic captions, animated text, a series intro or end card, or when text has to hit the beat.

| Category | Level | Time | Uses | Version |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| [Create](../README.md) | intermediate | 20–40 min per short (first time 1 h) | `@useclaudia/media`, `@useclaudia/cli` | 1.0.0 · 2026-10-12 |

## How it works

1. Write the words before the motion
2. Build the beat grid
3. Check reading time and position
4. Pick a route and build the layers
5. Land each move on the beat
6. Use AI video only behind the type
7. Export and view it on a phone
8. Save the look as a series kit

The full instructions are in **[SKILL.md](SKILL.md)**: when to use it, what you need, every step, the checks before you
finish, and the pitfalls.
